Definition: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
BiblicalUsage: 1) to rejoice, be glad; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rejoice; 1a2) to rejoice (arrogantly), exult (at); 1a3) to rejoice (religiously); 1b) (Piel) to cause to rejoice, gladden, make glad; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to rejoice, gladden, make glad
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
